title: Hopf Conjecture: no metric of positive sectional curvature on S^2 x S^2
exact_target: Can the product of two two-spheres carry any Riemannian metric with positive sectional curvature in every tangent two-plane?

sources.citation: W. Ziller, Examples of Riemannian Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature, arXiv:math/0701389v3 [math.DG], 2007.
